question.entity_id: Secretary of the Interior acting pursuant to EO:13792
question.proposition: Did the Secretary submit the Final Report identified in the DOI testimony for consideration to the President?

candidate.entity_id: Secretary of the Interior acting pursuant to EO:13792

source.edition: DOI January 30, 2018 written testimony, retained HTML

candidate.text: In response to strong local concerns about egregious past abuses of the Act, President Trump signed Executive Order 13792 on April 26, 2017, which tasked the Secretary to conduct a review of all Presidential designations or expansions of designations under the Antiquities Act since January 1, 1996, that exceeded 100,000 acres, or any others that were made without coordination and outreach to the public. The Secretary, in accordance with the Executive Order, submitted two reports for consideration to the President. The first was an Interim Report specifically addressing the Bears Ears National Monument. The Final Report features an assessment of 27 monuments, which was informed by travel to eight monument sites; dozens of meetings with stakeholders, ranging from tribal, local, and state officials to conservation organizations; and the first ever formal comment period tied to the Antiquities Act.

start_basis.reason: The same paragraph places the submission in accordance with this specific order, signed April 26, 2017. Issuance only bounds the event below.

source.edition: DOI January 30, 2018 written testimony, retained HTML

end_basis.reason: The dated testimony expressly describes the two submissions in the past tense. Its date bounds the fact above; it is not an observed date of delivery.
